GOOD MORNING AND HAPPY TUESDAY![image][image]GREAT NEWS! The K9 license plates are arriving and hitting the road! My good friend Joe just got his, and it looks great![image][image]Every plate features SG for Sean Gannon and a picture of Nero, our hero, who is still alive and doing well! OVER 5,000 PLATES HAVE BEEN ORDERED![image][image]The proceeds help care for our retired police and military K9s across the Commonwealth and support Dakota’s Law and Nero’s Law. A great way to show love and respect for our four-legged heroes![image][image]JOIN US THIS SUNDAY at 9 AM at Bourne High School for the first-ever K9 PTSD 5K Road Race! There’s still time to order your plate, too![image][image]Have a TERRIFIC TUESDAY! God bless! GOOD MORNING EVERYONE! [image]Happy Columbus Day! I hope you all have a great day. The weather will get better![image][image]If you get a chance, please check out this special War Dog Monument at Hathaway Pond in the Town of Barnstable. It’s a beautiful spot with a dog park and pond, right here in the center of Cape Cod.[image][image]Thanks to my good friend Steve Luciani of Coachlight Carpets, and Kim Maki of Maki Monuments who made this monument happen. I was honored to be there for the dedication and stopped by for a visit the other day. It’s a wonderful tribute to the brave canines who have served alongside our military in different wars. Our four-legged heroes deserve to be remembered and honored, too. [image][image]And speaking of our love for dogs, don’t forget the FIRST EVER K9 5K on Sunday, October 18, at 9 AM at Bourne High School! Come out and support a great cause.[image][image]Have a wonderful day, everyone. We are grateful for all those who have served, those serving today, and the next generation who will carry on that proud tradition.[image][image]To all the parents and family members of our sailors, be proud! LOOK WHO’S GROWING BIGGER AND MORE HANDSOME EVERY DAY! [image][image]Zohaib Malik-Mohammed, who we affectionately nicknamed Little Z, and his family spent Columbus Day weekend up in New Hampshire enjoying the beautiful White Mountains. What a great way to end the weekend with this picture of our little buddy! Tomorrow, he’s back to school at Oak Ridge School, where this nine-year-old fourth grader continues to grow and thrive.[image][image]It’s truly amazing when you think about how far this young man has come. Four years ago, Little Z was rescued from drowning at Snake Pond thanks to the incredible citizens and first responders who stepped up, along with the doctors and nurses who helped save his life. We welcomed him home after 12 weeks in Boston-area hospitals with our Big Nick’s Ride motorcycles, police cruisers, and fire trucks, and we’ve been cheering him on ever since.[image][image]His family has stayed strong, his teachers are angels, and Little Z is an angel among us right here in the Fightin’ Fifth District. He’s strong, kind, handsome, and an inspiration to all of us.[image][image]THANK YOU to every single person who played a part in saving this young man’s life and helping him continue to grow, thrive, and enjoy being a kid.[image][image]We love you, Little Z! Keep smiling, keep growing, and keep being YOU! PROUD AND HONORED![image]Massachusetts State Police[image][image]I’m proud to have the endorsement and support of the State Police Association of Massachusetts, representing the men, women, and K9s in blue who serve and protect our Commonwealth.[image][image]This means a lot to me personally. Serving and protecting others has been my life and the life of my family. As a retired police officer and law enforcement family, I will always stand with those who put their lives on the line for others.[image][image]Thank you to the State Police Association of Massachusetts for your support and confidence.[image][image]God bless, and stay safe, Troopers!
